sentences.text:
The following relief has been claimed in the instant petition:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent nos. 1 and 2 to declare the land acquisition initiated by notification no.
33/77-3-2009-298 Acquisition/08 dated 17.01.2009
3. The admitted case of the petitioner is that some part of his land of khasra no. 443-Ga/443M was acquired and an award was also declared.
The petitioner also received compensation for an area measuring 1.16 hectares.
According to him, he was left with 0.1000 hectares.
The contention is that for the said part of the land no award has been made.
4. Sri A.B. Singhal, learned counsel for the respondent authority submits that the aforesaid area was not acquired and therefore, award was not made.
The authority has also not taken possession of the aforesaid land.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance on paragraphs 17 and 19 of the writ petition in contending that the fourth respondent had erected a bill board near the land of the petitioner and the officials of the respondent authority have been making attempt to encroach over the petitioner's land and therefore, the petitioner apprehends that he would be dispossessed.
6.

Sri A.B. Singhal, learned counsel for the respondent authority reiterates his submission that the possession of the petitioner in respect of 1000 Sqm. of land which was not acquired will not be disturbed except in accordance with law.
7. In view of the aforesaid statement, no further direction is required to be issued.
The instant petition stands disposed of.

(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 6.11.2024 PS  Maharaj Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120863988/
